gloss: to worship, to pray, to bow in reverence

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {拝|おが}んでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: To show religious reverence by bowing or pressing palms together.
To earnestly request something from someone.
To have the honor of seeing something (humble expression).

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{拝|おが}む。
examples.english: I press my hands together and pray at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦どうか→どうか：09854_douka⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いします：00981_onegaishimasu⟧、⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{拝|おが}んだ。
⟦{初|はつ}{日|ひ}の{出|で}→初日の出：10452_hatsuhinode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝|おが}む。
examples.english: I view the first sunrise of the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{静|しず}かに→静か：00755_shizuka⟧{拝|おが}んだ。
examples.english: I prayed quietly in front of the Buddha statue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧、⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝|おが}む⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It is my daily routine to pray at the family altar every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦くれ→くれる：00724_kureru⟧、⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{拝|おが}む⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He pleaded, almost begging, asking to be helped.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}でも→何でも：00304_nandemo⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{拝|おが}み⟦{倒|たお}した→倒す：01954_taosu⟧。
examples.english: I begged with everything I had, saying I would do anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝|おが}む⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I had the honor of seeing Mount Fuji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝|おが}めて⟦うれしい→うれしい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I am glad to have the pleasure of seeing your face after such a long time.

notes:
{拝|おが}む means to worship or show reverence by pressing palms together or bowing.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle: ⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝|おが}む

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{拝|おが}む: to pray with hands together
- ⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝|おが}む: to worship Buddha
- ⟦{初|はつ}{日|ひ}の{出|で}→初日の出：10452_hatsuhinode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝|おが}む: to view the first sunrise

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese people {拝|おが}む at temples and shrines. At Buddhist temples, one puts palms together; at Shinto shrines, one claps twice before praying.
